# With-defaults cases for scripts/yanglint-oracle.sh: yanglint -t data -d <mode>
# (no -d for explicit) over ex-wd.yang and ietf-netconf-with-defaults.
# name             mode         input
wd-explicit        explicit     ex-wd.xml
wd-all             all          ex-wd.xml
wd-tagged          all-tagged   ex-wd.xml
wd-trim            trim         ex-wd.xml
wd-np-explicit     explicit     ex-wd-np.xml
wd-np-all          all          ex-wd-np.xml
wd-np-tagged       all-tagged   ex-wd-np.xml
wd-when-on         all          ex-wd-when-on.xml
wd-when-off        all          ex-wd-when-off.xml
